briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 deployment accelerates AGI timeline as China races to match

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaling laws further with Orion-2 and Gemini 3 while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute shortages persist despite massive buildouts. Global AI race intensifies toward potential AGI milestones in 2027.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases Orion-2 with 15% gains on agentic tasks. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3 enter preview. Meta open-sources Llama 4.5 while xAI Colossus cluster trains next Grok iteration.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive CAN bus deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields improve for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from US labs or a coordinated international effort by 2028?
